rationale: C01 supplies an almost verbatim, provision-for-provision template for the child: a dispute between a named railroad and represented employees; failure of Railway Labor Act adjustment; the National Mediation Board's finding of threatened interruption of interstate commerce within specified states; a thirty-day reporting requirement; and the section 10 prohibition on changing the disputed conditions. The child mainly substitutes the carrier, union, and affected states. C03 and C21 use the same machinery and language, but their singular or two-state formulations are slightly less textually congruent with the child's plural-state wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Company a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Switchmen's Union of North America, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Chicago, North Shore & Milwaukee Railway Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International union of Amalgamated Association of Street Electric Railway and Motor Coach Employees of America, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The opening clause has the same detailed grammatical structure, with only the carrier and labor organization changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended

shared_material.child_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the States of Colorado, New Mexico and Utah to a degree such as to deprive those states of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the States of Illinois and Wisconsin to a degree such as to deprive those States of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive multi-state threat finding is reproduced nearly verbatim with new state names.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days form the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The operative reporting requirement is identical apart from an apparent typographical error in the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Chicago, North Shore & Milwaukee Railway Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory standstill mechanism and full sentence structure are retained, substituting only the railroad.
